name: Live Bento Grid
description: A hairline bento grid for an analytics product: six tiles, each with a live illustration in markup, from a self-drawing chart to a pulsing dot-map.

props.name: heading
props.description: Plain part of the section heading.

props.name: headingItalic
props.description: Italic serif ending of the heading.

props.name: trend
props.type: TileCopy & { dates; metrics: { name; total; delta; points: number[] }[] }
props.description: Line-chart tile. The chart draws itself, then morphs between metrics every 4.2s until someone picks one.

props.name: stat
props.type: TileCopy & { value: number; unit: string; comparison }
props.description: Accent tile: one number that counts up, plus two comparison bars.

props.name: heatmap
props.description: Weekday × hour heatmap tile; cells keep ticking while visible.

props.name: search
props.description: Search tile that types each question and then shows its answer.

props.name: alerts
props.type: TileCopy & { settings: { label; detail; on }[]; preview }
props.description: Settings card of real switches that flip themselves until touched; the preview message follows the watched switch.

props.name: map
props.type: TileCopy & { liveLabel: string; cities: { name; lon; lat; visitors }[] }
props.description: Dark tile: dot-matrix world map with pulsing cities, a live total and the top four cities.
